title: Short hostname 'db' won't resolve even though its DNS record is correct
description_md:
An app on this box is configured to reach its database at the short hostname `db` (not a fully-qualified name), on port 8080. It used to work fine; now every lookup fails, even though the internal DNS record for `db` is correct and the database itself is healthy. A zone rename happened recently. SSH in as `trainee` (passwordless `sudo`), figure out why a short name that used to resolve now doesn't, and fix it.

You're done when `curl http://db:8080/` succeeds.
